app.description: Red, yellow, green post-its. A real terminal behind each one.
state.question: question
html.broadcast: type once, every ticked lab gets it…
html.bash_hint: a bash in this lab's dir, bottom of the screen
html.name: name
ui.empty_3: , running on its own somewhere. Hit
ui.confirm_start: Respawn "{name}"? Whatever runs there now gets killed.
ui.confirm_stop: Kill "{name}"? The process dies, the post-it stays.
ui.confirm_delete: rm "{name}" from the wall? The process dies. The dir is not touched.
drop.stalled:
{label}
no progress for {s}s · Esc to abort
drop.too_big_file: {path}: too big for a zip. Alt + drop sends it raw.
drop.too_big_dir: dir too big for a zip. Alt + drop sends it raw.
drop.too_many: too many files for a zip. Alt + drop sends them raw.
drop.proxy_413: 413 from your reverse proxy: body too big. Raise its limit for this route (docs/caddy.md).
journal.question: wants an answer
journal.empty: Nothing yet. Every question, every lab that settles or dies ends up here.
push.on_hint: push is on. Click to fire a test one.
push.off_hint: turn on push on this device
push.denied: the browser said no to notifications
push.question: ❓ {lab} wants an answer
err.machine_name: empty machine name, or the hub already uses it
err.no_tmux: no tmux. POSTERM is built on it; install tmux >= 3.1
err.no_shell: that lab's bash isn't running. Open it first.
err.stale_dir: {dir} is not where that bash is. Drop again.
log.join_token: generated join token for spokes: {token}  (kept in {path}). On each spoke: POSTERM_TOKEN=<this> posterm join <hub-url>. It opens /join and nothing else.
log.secrets_rejected: {path} is not ours (wrong owner or not a directory): moved to {aside}, never trusted. Rotate the token if a lab could have planted it.
log.secret_moved: moved {from} into {to}: the labs can't read it anymore
log.hub_cleartext: refusing to send the token in cleartext to {url}. Use https:// (or set POSTERM_INSECURE=1 if you really mean it).
log.spoke_refused: hub refused this spoke (HTTP {code}). Check POSTERM_TOKEN (the hub's join token) and POSTERM_NAME.
log.need_root: running as {name} (POSTERM_USER/POSTERM_GROUP) needs root to start with
log.tmux_owner: a tmux server owned by {who} still runs labs on {sock}. Kill it (tmux -S {sock} kill-server) or set POSTERM_USER={who}.
log.no_login_shell: {name} has no login shell, labs get {shell}
cli.usage:
{title} — the lab wall

  posterm                       run the hub (web wall + this machine's labs)
  posterm join [hub-url]        publish this machine's labs to a hub (POSTERM_HUB)
  posterm lab <dir> [cmd…]      spawn a lab here (no cmd = login shell)
  posterm state <question|idle> [text…]   from inside a lab: say where it is
                                (French alias: posterm etat <question|pose>)

Config: env vars or a .env file. See .env.example.
cli.etat_usage: usage, from inside a lab: posterm state <question|idle> [text…]
cli.join_needs: need the hub URL (argument or POSTERM_HUB) and its join token (POSTERM_TOKEN)
cli.lab_started:
lab "{id}" spawned in {dir}
  attach: tmux -S {sock} attach -t {id}
